U.S. Attorney’s Office for Northern Ohio Joins DOJ Fraud Division and IRS Partners in National Tax Enforcement Surge Exposing Millions in Tax Fraud October 15, 2026 FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE U.S. Department of Labor, Office of Inspector General More than 30 U.S. Attorney’s Offices joined the Fraud Division in bringing enforcement actions against alleged fraudsters CLEVELAND – The U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Northern District of Ohio announced several enforcement actions as part of a nationwide effort led by the Justice Department’s National Fraud Enforcement Division, Internal Revenue Service (IRS), and the IRS Criminal Investigation (IRS-CI) Division targeting tax fraud and related offenses.
